welcome.eyebrow: A letter to our Blue Bird family
welcome.title: You belong here.
paragraphs: Perhaps you still remember a classroom, a favourite teacher, or the friend who saved you a seat. Whatever your batch, those small moments are part of a story we share.
We hope to build a place to pick up old conversations and begin new ones. Come with your memories, your ideas, and a little time for one another. Let's make the next chapter together.
